title: Collab: drop the y-webrtc-eu.fly.dev fallback from DEFAULT_SIGNALING_SERVERS (keep only signal.dash.jxh.io)
description:
DONE (2026-06-21). Dropped the third-party wss://y-webrtc-eu.fly.dev fallback from DEFAULT_SIGNALING_SERVERS; signal.dash.jxh.io is now the SOLE built-in default. Field stays user-editable (parse/get/setSignalingServers unchanged).

CHANGES:
- packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/signaling.ts: DEFAULT_SIGNALING_SERVERS = ['wss://signal.dash.jxh.io'] only; rewrote file header + export doc-comment for single-default privacy posture; getSignalingServers docstring no longer says 'public default'.
- packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/__tests__/signaling.test.ts: updated 'public default' wording; added task-1356 assertion (default equals exactly ['wss://signal.dash.jxh.io'] and does NOT contain fly.dev).
- packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/ShareDialog.tsx: label '(using public default)' -> '(using default)'; helper text now says the default is our own server.
- docs/37-collab.md: §8.4 + §13.5 list rewritten — our worker is the SOLE default, fly.dev fallback dropped, privacy rationale documented.

VERIFY: full ordered build green (pnpm --filter './packages/**' build, 8 pkgs Done). @flash/authoring-ui suite 1158/1158 pass; signaling.test.ts 5/5 in isolation. No remaining fly.dev refs except the test's negative assertion + docs note.
